# Rule order_total v1

The total of an order: its subtotal, the VAT of its category at the rate of the rule vat_rate of the module tax, and the shipping fee

## Inputs

| Name | Type | Range | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| subtotal | money[GBPc] | 0GBPc to 2_000_000GBPc |  |
| category | category (3 values) |  |  |
| shipping | money[GBPc] | 0GBPc to 10_000GBPc |  |

## Outputs

| Name | Type | Rounding | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| total | money[GBPc] | half_up(1GBPc) |  |

## Types

An enum is a **closed** finite set. Add a value, and every table that does not look at it fails the completeness check.

- **category** (3 values) — standard, reduced, zero

## Applied rule vat: @tax/rules/vat_rate.rule (module example.com/acme/tax 1.0.0) (unpinned)

Rule **vat_rate** v1 is applied with the following substitutions.

The rate of VAT for a category of goods: standard 20%, reduced 5%, zero 0%. The rates are the example's own

| Callee input | What this rule passes | Value mapping |
|---|---|---|
| category | category |  |

| Callee output | Its name in this rule |
|---|---|
| rate | vat_rate |

|---|---|
| category | Input |
| → rate | Output of this rule |

| # | category | → rate (rate / down(1%)) |

| 1 | standard | 20% |

**What `rulec check` verified of the callee**

- Every combination of inputs matches some row (E101 completeness)
- There is no row that can never match (E102 unreachable row)
- No input matches two or more rows at once (E105 overlap). Reordering the rows does not change the meaning

## Result

`subtotal + subtotal * vat_rate + shipping`

| subtotal | category | shipping | → total |

| 1000GBPc | standard | 395GBPc | 1595GBPc |
| 1000GBPc | reduced | 395GBPc | 1445GBPc |
| 999GBPc | reduced | 0GBPc | 1049GBPc |
